name: Is AEO more important for some local business types than others?

mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important for some local business types than others?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is generally beneficial for all local business types, but it can be particularly critical for those with common, straightforward customer inquiries or where immediate information is highly valued. This includes service-based businesses (plumbers, electricians, salons), restaurants (hours, menus, reservations), healthcare providers (appointments, services), and retail stores (inventory, hours, location). Businesses that rely heavily on 'near me' searches or impulse decisions also gain significant advantages. Less complex services with clear answers benefit most, as AEO thrives on providing direct, concise responses to specific user needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO is critical for all local businesses, especially those with common customer inquiries like service providers, restaurants, healthcare, and retail, where immediate information is highly valued.
